description: High-risk Annex III 1(c): emotion-recognition systems outside the workplace and education (where Art. 5(1)(f) prohibition does not apply). High-risk (WARN + obligations). Illustrative only; synthetic text.

positives.text: Infer the emotional state of retail customers from in-store camera video to adapt offers at the shelf.
Detect caller frustration from voice tone in the consumer hotline and route angry callers differently.
Leite aus Kamera-Video im Laden den Gefühlszustand der Kunden ab, um Angebote am Regal anzupassen.
Erkenne Frust aus dem Stimmklang in der Verbraucher-Hotline und leite verärgerte Anrufer anders weiter.

hard_negatives.text: Count how many customers enter the store each hour, with no inference about feelings.
Zähle, wie viele Kunden pro Stunde den Laden betreten, ohne Rückschluss auf Gefühle.
